actual_coverage.coverage_limit: Complete region inspection is not an exhaustive pixel membership reading. No new footprint, centerline or quantified uncertainty was obtained. Numerical locators below are broad visual navigation proposals, not measured ink bounds.

placement_rule: Use saved PDF CTMs, not a uniform joined image. Im3/Im4 height is 42.2400055 PDF points for 88 rows; Im5 is 41.9400024 for 88 rows. Read both sides of each seam separately; nearby endpoints alone do not establish continuity.
shared_assignment_rule: Composed legend identifies black as three bolts, solid as spring and dashed as shell. Local continuous/broken shape motivates provisional fragments. No assignment is based solely on height or expected mechanics. At a shared black crossing both identities remain possible. No attributed stroke means neither zero load nor a validated physical gap.

records.disposition: Locally readable ascending continuous black fragments; crowded initial departure and cross-strip continuity not recovered.
records.cue: In Im4 a continuous black rising stroke is locally distinguishable from the broken black rising sequence. In Im3 the continuous stroke ascends to a visibly angular crest before turning down. Im5 contains a congested origin and low-rise bundle.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: At the origin and intersections with colored strokes, shared dark/antialiased cells may belong to the axis, another curve or F3. No specific dark cell there is assigned uniquely. Im3's crest crossing is separately withheld.
records.boundary_or_axis: Im5 origin and baseline/ticks contaminate initial departure; rise crosses both strip seams.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Source-native footprint and uncertainty reading of the separated rising fragments; a higher-fidelity pre-raster trace or independently defensible tracing constraint for obscured origin/intersections. Neither can be supplied by assumed load ordering.

records.disposition: Multiple local rising black dashes visible; no joined whole rising trace.
records.cue: Repeated short black segments and intervening light gaps ascend in Im4 and approach the rounded/broken crest in Im3. Separation from the locally continuous stroke supports provisional dashed identity, not its relative height alone.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Near the origin, colored/black coincidence and axis proximity prevent unique assignment. Ordinary-looking dash intervals remain unbridged; interruption by overlap or seam clipping is not established as a dash gap.
records.boundary_or_axis: Im5 origin/baseline and both strip seams; no endpoints inferred from strip clipping.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Individual dash footprints and source-native uncertainty where separated, plus original plotting information or justified local disambiguation at overlap. No interpolation across all gaps is authorized.

records.disposition: Continuous angular crest and adjacent fragments locally readable; shared black crossing remains unresolved.
records.cue: An uninterrupted black line reaches an angular maximum and slopes downward toward the broken black crest. The continuous and broken styles are distinguishable away from contact.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Within the contact/crossing zone, dark cells may represent either or both models. No pixel-wise path through the contact is recovered. This does not make the entire crest unreadable.
records.boundary_or_axis: Lower edge clips approaching/leaving pieces; no axis contamination identified inside this crest locator.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Footprints for the visibly isolated pre-contact crest, then a higher-fidelity trace or validated treatment preserving both assignments through contact. A crest location alone cannot establish an original-line peak error bound.

records.disposition: Broken rounded crest fragments locally readable; contact with the solid descent unresolved.
records.cue: Short dark segments form a shallow crest beside the angular continuous route, with visible local gaps away from the crossing.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: At black-on-black contact the source cannot uniquely assign ink to one route. Dashed phase cannot be propagated through hidden cells merely by fitting a smooth crest.
records.boundary_or_axis: Im3 lower boundary clips route pieces; no axis contact in this locator.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Separated dash footprint/uncertainty reading and original plotting trace or bounded competing crossing reconstructions. No smoothing or assumed spring/shell ordering.

records.disposition: Completed Im4 corridor retained; locally continuous descent visible, crossing and both boundary connections not recovered.
records.cue: Continuous black falling stroke in Im4 is distinct locally from separate descending dashes. Existing two-reader column annotations 270–359 remain the detailed evidence and are not rerecorded as new findings.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Earlier outer/core/fringe differences remain. Im3 contact and Im5 baseline approach cannot be resolved by extending the Im4 line.
records.boundary_or_axis: Im4 top/bottom clipping; Im5 baseline/tick contamination considered separately in tail.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Use frozen corridor data; calibrate original-line uncertainty and settle admissible disconnected support. Boundary/crest ambiguity needs source-level evidence, not another count of identical set operations.

records.disposition: Completed Im4 individual-dash corridor retained; no continuous physical support inferred across its gaps.
records.cue: Repeated separated black falling strokes accompany the continuous descent; the previous exact annotations preserve multiple fragments per column where present.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Existing reader differences and dash endpoints remain; not every empty column is a genuine physical interruption. No identity is propagated through Im3 contact or onto the axis.
records.boundary_or_axis: Top/bottom clipping separates partial dashes from verified dash endpoints; Im5 tail approaches ticks.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Reuse the frozen per-dash readings without joining holes. Defensible source-native uncertainty, seam treatment and gap semantics are required before physical support or sample selection.

records.disposition: Readable short continuous approach toward the baseline; endpoint and zero-capacity tail not recovered.
records.cue: Continuous black descent enters Im5 from its top and curves/shallowly approaches the horizontal black axis. The broken companion remains separately visible over part of this approach.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Where the line meets ticks/axis, black cells could be line, tick, axis or a mixture. A long horizontal black run cannot be assigned to F3 merely because the descent reaches it.
records.boundary_or_axis: Top entry clipped; baseline and vertical ticks overlap the terminal approach.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Separated pre-contact footprint and source-native uncertainty; original trace or a defensible endpoint bound distinguishing curve from axis. Do not infer exact zero, rupture displacement or persistence along the axis.

records.disposition: Short broken approach visible; final dash identity and endpoint at axis unresolved.
records.cue: Short black segments descend beside the continuous tail toward baseline/tick ink; their separated portions provisionally retain dashed style.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: The final interruption could be a normal dash interval, overlap or termination. Near the baseline, dash/tick/axis ink is not uniquely separable.
records.boundary_or_axis: Top-clipped fragment; lower contact with axis/ticks.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Per-dash pre-contact footprints and uncertainty, with original trace or explicitly bounded competing endpoint assignments. No gap filling or zero-load declaration.

records.disposition: Both rising and falling arms reach this strip boundary; local shapes compatible, exact continuity not certified.
records.cue: The full strips show a rising continuous black piece on one side of the crest and a falling piece on the other at corresponding boundary neighborhoods. Saved CTMs place Im4 immediately below Im3, subject to published decimal precision.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Close endpoint locations do not prove a unique join; rising colored crossings and nearby black crest contact can contaminate individual edge cells.
records.boundary_or_axis: All boundary-truncated pieces remain clipped observations, not route endpoints. No baseline at this seam.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Read paired edge-cell footprints under actual CTMs with their uncertainty, preserving alternative joins where attribution remains ambiguous. No uniform concatenation or forced continuous curve.

records.disposition: Rising and falling dash neighborhoods inspected across boundary; dash phase and joins not recovered.

records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: An absent edge cell could be dash spacing or clipping/compression; visible proximity to the solid route does not identify shared cells. No single dash has been proven to span the seam.
records.boundary_or_axis: Separate native strip edges and ordinary dash breaks must not be conflated.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Independent edge footprints and uncertainty under the CTMs, including explicit no-attribution cases; original dash trace where crossing obscures membership.

records.disposition: Crowded rising arm and locally clearer falling arm inspected on both sides; continuity remains provisional.

records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: The more readable falling neighborhood cannot validate the crowded rising join. Source pitch change must be retained, even though both images have 88 rows.
records.boundary_or_axis: Im4 bottom/Im5 top clipping; axis is below the seam, but rising near-origin identity remains crowded.
records.additional_evidence_needed: Separate edge footprints and cell-edge transforms, with no forced joins; specific higher-fidelity input where rising colors overlap.

records.disposition: Both dash-arm boundary neighborhoods inspected; separated pieces present but no seam-crossing dash or complete join established.
records.cue: The broken falling approach remains visible on each side; rising pieces share the congested low-displacement bundle. Local gaps and strip edges are separately recognized.
records.unresolved_and_competing_assignments: Boundary proximity does not show whether a dash continues or ends before the seam. Crowded rising attribution remains ambiguous; no comparison uses uniform stitched row coordinates.
